blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY — In a bid to bolster its operational readiness and territorial defense capabilities, the Army’s 39th Infantry Battalion (39IB) has opened its newly constructed command facilities in the erstwhile conflict-torn town of Matanao in Davao del Sur. Maj. Gen. Alvin Luzon, commander of the 10th Infantry Division, and Davao del Sur Rep. John Tracy Cagas led the inauguration of the battalion’s new administration building and covered court in Barangay Asbang on Sunday, October 25.
